description:
Check the health status of the AutoMem service and its connected databases (FalkorDB graph + Qdrant vectors).

**When to use:**
- Before a session to verify the memory service is available
- When memory operations are failing unexpectedly
- To check storage statistics

**Example:**
- check_database_health({})
name: check_database_health

statistics.description: Memory/vector counts, sync_status, vector_dimensions and enrichment state, when provided.

status.description: degraded: reachable, but a backend or sync check needs attention.

title: Check Database Health
